description: Candidate public Facebook Pages for Rome local news, civic affairs, politics and public services. Page IDs are intentionally blank and must be verified before API collection.
important_notes: A listed public Page is not automatically accessible through the Meta Graph API.
For Pages you do not manage, request and obtain the applicable Meta Page Public Content Access feature/permissions before collecting their content.
Page IDs are intentionally left blank rather than guessed. Verify each Page ID through an approved API workflow or other reliable page details.
Use only data and engagement fields returned by Meta for your app and token. Likes/reactions and comments may be unavailable for some Pages/posts.
This file contains candidate sources, not a guarantee of current API access or approval.
